tagline.en: Skywork's Matrix-Game 1.0 — an interactive world model that generates a controllable game-style world from a starting image.
tagline.zh: Skywork 的 Matrix-Game 1.0——从起始图片生成可交互游戏式世界的世界模型。

en: Matrix-Game 1.0 is an interactive world model in the Matrix-Game family from Skywork. Given an initial image, it generates a controllable, game-like world you can move through.

The model is built from a diffusion transformer (DiT) with a dedicated text encoder and a video VAE, and WorldFoundry runs it through a vendored copy of the official runtime so behavior stays faithful to upstream.
In WorldFoundry you provide a starting image and let the pipeline generate the world. It is registered as its own model — separate from later Matrix-Game versions — with its own weights and runner.
zh: Matrix-Game 1.0 是 Skywork 推出的 Matrix-Game 家族中的交互式世界模型。给定一张初始图片,它便生成一个可操控、类似游戏的世界供你在其中移动。
该模型由扩散 Transformer(DiT)、专用文本编码器与视频 VAE 组成,WorldFoundry 通过内置的官方运行时副本运行它,使行为忠实于上游。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供一张起始图片,由 pipeline 生成世界。它作为独立模型注册——与后续 Matrix-Game 版本区分开——拥有自己的权重与运行器。

whenToUse.en: Choose Matrix-Game 1.0 when you want to spin up an interactive, game-style world from an image and explore it, using the original Matrix-Game generation stack.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张图片生成可交互的游戏式世界并加以探索,且希望使用初代 Matrix-Game 的生成栈时,可以选择 Matrix-Game 1.0。

notFor.en: It runs on an older CUDA/torch stack, so a modern NVIDIA unified environment is recommended. Checkpoints (DiT shards, text encoder, VAE) are downloaded separately and take significant disk space.
notFor.zh: 它基于较旧的 CUDA/torch 栈,因此建议在较新的 NVIDIA 统一环境中运行。Checkpoint(DiT 分片、文本编码器、VAE)需单独下载,占用较多磁盘空间。
